verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an official remote MCP server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents act on a WorkOS workspace, reading and changing the same dashboard data as the user (organizations, connections, users, branding). A probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. The AuthKit-for-MCP material is about securing your own MCP server, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documented detail on setup steps, authentication flow and the exposed tool list.
